text: Tommy had by this time the glibness born of practice. He rattled off the formula to the elderly woman, looking more like a housekeeper than a servant, who opened the door to him. “Christian name?” “Margaret.” Tommy spelt it, but the other interrupted him. “No, g u e.” “Oh, Marguerite; French way, I see.” He paused, then plunged boldly. “We had her down as Rita Vandemeyer, but I suppose that’s incorrect?” “She’s mostly called that, sir, but Marguerite’s her name.” “Thank you.
